# Build the locked upstream C implementation without its global build/install
# options. Keep it dynamically replaceable, including on Android (LGPL-2.1+).
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)
if(CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR STREQUAL CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR)
  project(TwilightSoxr VERSION 0.1.3 LANGUAGES C)
endif()
include(CheckCSourceCompiles)
include(TestBigEndian)
check_c_source_compiles("#if !defined(__SSE__) && !defined(__ARM_NEON) && !defined(__aarch64__)\n#error no SIMD32\n#endif\nint main(void) { return 0; }" TAE_SOXR_SIMD32)
set(WITH_CR32 1)
set(WITH_CR64 1)
set(WITH_CR32S ${TAE_SOXR_SIMD32})
set(WITH_CR64S 0)
set(WITH_PFFFT ${TAE_SOXR_SIMD32})
set(WITH_VR32 0)
set(WITH_HI_PREC_CLOCK 1)
set(HAVE_FENV_H 1)
set(HAVE_STDBOOL_H 1)
set(HAVE_STDINT_H 1)
set(HAVE_LRINT 1)
test_big_endian(HAVE_BIGENDIAN)
configure_file(upstream/soxr-config.h.in soxr-config.h)
set(sources soxr.c data-io.c dbesi0.c filter.c fft4g64.c cr.c cr32.c fft4g32.c cr64.c)
if(TAE_SOXR_SIMD32)
  list(APPEND sources cr32s.c pffft32s.c util32s.c)
endif()
list(TRANSFORM sources PREPEND "upstream/src/")
add_library(twilight_soxr SHARED ${sources})
set_target_properties(twilight_soxr PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME twilight-soxr
  PREFIX "lib"
  C_STANDARD 99 C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON
  RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}"
  LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}")
target_include_directories(twilight_soxr PUBLIC upstream/src PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}")
target_compile_definitions(twilight_soxr PRIVATE SOXR_LIB soxr_EXPORTS PUBLIC TAE_HAS_SOXR=1)
if(WIN32)
  target_compile_definitions(twilight_soxr PUBLIC SOXR_DLL)
else()
  target_compile_definitions(twilight_soxr PRIVATE SOXR_VISIBILITY)
  target_compile_options(twilight_soxr PRIVATE -fvisibility=hidden)
  target_link_libraries(twilight_soxr PRIVATE m)
endif()
if(MSVC)
  target_compile_definitions(twilight_soxr PRIVATE _USE_MATH_DEFINES _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS)
else()
  target_compile_options(twilight_soxr PRIVATE -O2 -ffp-contract=off -fno-fast-math)
endif()
if(ANDROID)
  target_link_options(twilight_soxr PRIVATE -Wl,-z,max-page-size=16384)
endif()
